title: 第10章 太子，她是你皇婶婶(2)
slug: 腹黑小狂后全本免费-腹黑小狂后最新章节列表
content_zh:
再看，夏侯擎天竟然在笑，他这么罕见地温柔对待一个小姑娘，让其他人大跌眼镜。
这个笑容如春风般和煦的人，还是大家认知中的那个喜怒无常，六亲不认的临江王么？
“十四叔，这位姑娘是——”
夏侯楠惊讶之余忍不住开始关注起玉绯烟来。
能入十四叔的眼，又被他这么呵护，这个少女到底是何方神圣？
而且，她竟然不怕夏侯擎天的戾气，不但拿眼珠子瞪他，还伸手打他，这是何等勇气可嘉！不过，这也更加说明蓝衣少女在夏侯擎天心里的位置，她敢这样，自然是十四叔骄纵的结果！
心里掂量了再三，夏侯楠决定把玉绯烟放到重要位置上。
更何况蓝裙少女皓齿星眸，姿容出众，一开口，娇音萦萦，任是夏侯楠身为皇子，见过各色佳人，可是和眼前这位粉妆少女比起来，她们就成了庸脂俗粉，的确引人注目。
“她是你的十四婶！”
见夏侯楠问起玉绯烟的身份，夏侯擎天的笑容高洁无瑕，极有欺骗性。可是这个笑容在玉绯烟眼里却恶劣至极，充满了恶魔的味道。
“小四，以后见着她记得要叫皇婶婶！”
夏侯擎天的话，让夏侯楠和玉绯烟同时愣住了。
“我不是，你不要乱说——”醒悟过来的玉绯烟牙齿咯咯作响。
这个混蛋！
毁人不倦很有趣么！
他还敢不敢更恶趣味一点！
玉绯烟开始怀念之前那段自由自在的日子。在她痊愈之后，夏侯擎天便离开，玉绯烟一边修武，一边给人治病，畅游江湖，乐得自在，她甚至凭借一手高超的医术打响了“玉罗刹”的名头，成为新起的风云人物……
可是，在她准备打道回忠义侯府的时候，这个家伙又冒了出来，劫走她，把她带到这里！他这是要干什么？
“乖，别闹了！难道你还在念着你那个花心自大又没有真本事的未婚夫？他长相不如爷，家世不如爷，能力不如爷，武功更是比不上爷！这种靠祖上荫庇的废物，甩了最好！爷一根指头都能碾死他，他哪配得上你呢！”夏侯擎天抚了抚玉绯烟浓密的头发，像顺毛摸猫儿一样。
看到他清贵俊美又异常真挚的脸，玉绯烟恨不得一个巴掌呼扇过去。

只是，她不敢……
即便通过太极养生泉，玉绯烟已经洗髓换筋，脱胎换骨，武功恢复了之前的六七成，可目前的她还是打不过夏侯擎天。
识时务者为俊杰！
面对这样高贵霸道的无赖，玉绯烟只能愤怒咬着嘴唇，努力地用最凶恶的眼神“秒杀”他！
她明明是夏侯楠的未婚妻，现在却在夏侯擎天的推波助澜下，一跃成为夏侯楠的皇婶婶。王爷，您这算是横刀夺爱？莫非皇室的人都这么乱来？
玉绯烟忽然觉得自己有些看不懂眼前的这个男人，他这么做到底有什么目的？这玩笑未免开得太大了！
难道夏侯擎天千里迢迢把她从秦治国抓来，就是为了和夏侯楠“偶遇”，再告诉对方，这是你皇婶婶？还有，他刚才说的“花心自大又没真本事”，这是形容夏侯楠么？好吧，这个形容的确很确切！她还真看不上夏侯楠！
玉绯烟并不知道她的这个猜测非常正确。正因为清楚夏侯楠从红星镇路过，夏侯擎天才等在这儿，唱了这么一出。
笑话！他怎么能让自己看中的猫儿变成侄儿媳妇呢！
娶玉绯烟？
凭他夏侯楠也配？！
突然冒出一个这么稚嫩的皇婶婶，让夏侯楠的心态起了奇妙的变化。
玉绯烟看上去顶多不超过十五岁，可是皇叔已经二十有一。这是老牛吃嫩草么？
皇叔的品味果然与众不同！
难怪他那么多年都不近女色，甚至传出断袖的名声，原来十四叔喜欢这样娇软萌乖的少女。而且听夏侯擎天的语气，这少女原本有婚约，还有未婚夫，难道他就喜欢这样强抢的戏码？
一时间，夏侯擎天在夏侯楠心里的彪悍值再次刷新，不由得想到了十四叔的光辉历史。
夏侯擎天是大周国当今天子夏侯君宇的十四弟，鼎鼎大名的临江王，更是一个传奇人物。
他出生没多久就被当做质子送到了秦治国，十岁才回到大周。在秦治国的十年，由于没有专人教养，又被有心人刻意纵容，这位王爷长歪了。

content_en:
Looking again, Xia Hou Qingtian was actually smiling. He treated a little girl with such rare tenderness, which surprised others.
Is this man with a smile as warm as the spring breeze still the moody King Linjiang that everyone knows and who doesn't recognize his relatives?
"Uncle Fourteen, this girl is-"
Xia Hounan was surprised and couldn't help but start to pay attention to Yu Feiyan.
Who is this young girl who can fall into Uncle Fourteen's eyes and is so cared for by him?
Moreover, she was not afraid of Xia Hou Qingtian's anger. She not only stared at him with her eyes, but also reached out to hit him. What a commendable courage! However, this also further illustrates the position of the girl in blue in Xiahou Qingtian's heart. If she dares to do this, it is naturally the result of the arrogance of the fourteenth uncle!
After careful consideration, Xia Hounan decided to put Yu Feiyan in an important position.
What's more, the girl in the blue dress has bright teeth and starry eyes, and her appearance is outstanding. When she opens her mouth, her charming voice lingers. As a prince, Xia Hounan has seen all kinds of beauties, but compared with the girl with pink makeup in front of him, they all become vulgar and pink, which is indeed eye-catching.
"She is your fourteenth aunt!"
Seeing Xia Hounan ask about Yu Feiyan's identity, Xiahou Qingtian's smile was pure and flawless, which was extremely deceptive. But in Yu Feiyan's eyes, this smile was extremely evil and full of devilish flavor.
"Xiaosi, remember to call her Auntie Huang when you see her in the future!"
Xia Hou Qingtian's words made Xia Hounan and Yu Feiyan stunned at the same time.
"I'm not, don't talk nonsense -" Yu Feiyan's teeth chattered as she woke up.
This bastard!
Isn't it fun to be tireless?
Does he dare to be more naughty?
Jade Feiyan began to miss the free days before. After she recovered, Xia Hou Qingtian left. Yu Feiyan practiced martial arts, treated people, and traveled around the world, enjoying herself freely. She even earned the name "Jade Rakshasa" with her superb medical skills and became a rising figure...
However, when she was about to return to the Zhongyi Hou Mansion, this guy showed up again, kidnapped her, and brought her here! What is he going to do?
"Good boy, stop it! Are you still thinking about your fiancé who is arrogant and has no real ability? His appearance is not as good as mine, his family background is not as good as mine, his ability is not as good as mine, and his martial arts skills are not as good as mine! It's best to get rid of this kind of trash who relies on the shadow of his ancestors! I can crush him with one finger, how can he be worthy of you!" Xiahou Qingtian stroked Yu Feiyan's thick hair, like a cat's hair.
Seeing his noble, handsome and extremely sincere face, Yu Feiyan wanted to slap him in the face.
But, she didn't dare...
Even though Yu Feiyan had gone through the Tai Chi health spring, her marrow had been washed, her muscles had been regenerated, and her martial arts had returned to 60 to 70% of what it was before. However, she still couldn't beat Xia Hou Qingtian.
He who knows the current affairs is a hero!
Facing such a noble and domineering scoundrel, Yu Feiyan could only bite her lips angrily and try her best to "kill" him instantly with the most ferocious eyes!
She was obviously Xia Hounan's fiancée, but now, with the help of Xia Hou Qingtian, she became Xia Hounan's royal aunt. My lord, are you trying to win love with a sword? Could it be that everyone in the royal family is acting like this?
Yu Feiyan suddenly felt that she couldn't understand the man in front of her. What was his purpose in doing this? This joke is too big!
Could it be that Xia Hou Qingtian traveled all the way to capture her from Qin Zhiguo just to "encounter" Xia Hounan and tell him that this is your imperial aunt? Also, what he just said was "arrogant and arrogant but has no real ability". Does this describe Xia Hounan? Well, this description is indeed accurate! She really looks down on Xia Hounan!
Jade Feiyan didn't know that her guess was very correct. Just because he knew that Xia Hounan was passing by Hongxing Town, Xia Houqing waited here and sang like this.
joke! How could he let the cat he liked turn into his nephew-in-law!
Marry Yu Feiyan?
Is he worthy of Xia Hounan? !The sudden appearance of such a naive aunt made Xia Hounan's mentality change wonderfully.
Yu Feiyan looked to be no more than fifteen years old at most, but the emperor's uncle was already twenty-one. Is this an old cow eating young grass?
Uncle Huang’s taste is indeed different!
No wonder he had not been close to women for so many years, and even had a reputation as a broken sleeve. It turned out that Uncle Fourteen liked such a soft and cute girl. And judging from Xia Hou Qingtian's tone, this girl was originally engaged and had a fiancé. Could it be that he liked such a robbery scene?
For a moment, Xia Hou Qingtian's toughness in Xia Hou Nan's heart was refreshed again, and he couldn't help but think of the glorious history of his fourteenth uncle.
Xiahou Qingtian is the fourteenth younger brother of Xiahou Junyu, the current emperor of the Great Zhou Kingdom, the famous King Linjiang, and a legendary figure.
Not long after he was born, he was sent as a hostage to Qin Zhiguo, and did not return to Dazhou until he was ten years old. During the ten years of Qin's rule, due to lack of professional education and deliberate connivance by caring people, the prince became crooked.
